name: Apixaban
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 5 mg twice daily; 2.5 mg twice daily if at least 2 of: age ≥80 years, weight ≤60 kg, serum creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL

usual_adult_dose.indication: DVT prophylaxis after hip or knee replacement
usual_adult_dose.dose: 2.5 mg twice daily (35 days hip, 12 days knee)
10 mg twice daily for 7 days, then 5 mg twice daily

usual_adult_dose.indication: Reduce recurrent DVT/PE after initial therapy

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir)
key_interactions.effect: Higher apixaban exposure and bleeding risk.
key_interactions.action: On 5 or 10 mg twice daily: cut the dose by 50%. On 2.5 mg twice daily: avoid the combination. (Clarithromycin: no adjustment.)

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers (e.g., rifampin, carbamazepine, phenytoin, St. John's wort)
key_interactions.effect: Lower apixaban exposure; more stroke and thromboembolism.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Antiplatelets, aspirin, fibrinolytics, heparin, chronic NSAIDs
key_interactions.effect: Higher bleeding risk (ARISTOTLE: aspirin raised bleeding from 1.8% to 3.4% per year).
key_interactions.action: Weigh the need; watch for bleeding.

common: Children: headache, vomiting, heavy menstrual bleeding (≥10%)
serious: Thrombotic events after premature discontinuation (boxed warning)
Spinal/epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia or puncture (boxed warning)

monitoring: Signs of bleeding; hemoglobin when clinically indicated
Serum creatinine, age and weight to check the atrial fibrillation dose criteria

pk.dialyzability: Minimal: dialysis clearance about 18 mL/min; exposure 14% lower on dialysis (label).

sources.citation: E.R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C.. (2026). ELIQUIS (apixaban) [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, NDA202155, set ID e9481622-7cc6-418a-acb6-c5450daae9b0, version effective August 17, 2026]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

draft_notes: ESKD half-life left blank: neither the label nor the Mavrakanas 2017 abstract (PubMed) reports one; that study showed accumulation on 2.5 mg twice daily and only 4% removal per session.
Monitoring lines are drawn from the dose rule and bleeding warning; the label does not list routine laboratory monitoring.
